# linux_package (Data Source)

Tells whether a package is installed, and which version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "linux_package" "docker" {
  name = "docker-ce"
}

output "docker_version" {
  value = data.linux_package.docker.installed ? data.linux_package.docker.version : "not installed"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the package.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Name of the package.
- `installed` (Boolean) Whether the package is installed.
- `package_manager` (String) Package manager of the host.
- `version` (String) Installed version, null when the package is not installed.
